body:
The datafile path methods don't properly handle custom DATAFILE and DATAFILE_TMP settings when a suffix is provided. If a user explicitly configures these paths in TEST settings, all parallel workers will attempt to use the same datafile path, causing conflicts.

When suffix is provided, custom datafile paths should also incorporate the suffix. For example, if DATAFILE is set to '/path/to/custom.dbf', it should become '/path/to/custom_1.dbf' for suffix '1'. This can be done by appending the suffix before the file extension.

body:
The credentials restoration logic should only execute when destroying the main test database (suffix is None), not when destroying clones. When suffix is not None, we're destroying a cloned user/tablespace, and the connection should remain configured with the main test user's credentials. The restoration at lines 270-275 should be conditional on suffix being None.

Currently, this code would incorrectly restore credentials even when destroying clones, which is unnecessary and could potentially cause issues.
